verdict.rationale: Sentry's Seer debugging agent and its Autofix feature are documented to automatically root-cause issues and generate suggested code fixes for errors and performance issues. That root cause analysis can be handed off to coding agents for fix generation and PR creation. Suspect Commits, enabled by code mappings, links issues to related commits. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that Seer's analysis draws on stack traces, breadcrumbs and commits together; independent or hands-on corroboration of root-cause accuracy; and a separate Seer subscription is required.
